annotations.text:
1 — Dashboard, reframed

Opens with the Global Knowledge-Loss Index instead of a decorative hero, and ranks facilities worst-first as dense rows with decay sparklines. Same tokens as the live app.

2 — Facility report

Adds the knowledge-decay timeline across 7 archive snapshots, and an archived-proof link on every removed instrument so a judge can verify the claim.

3 — Instrument atlas (new)

Pivots the corpus by instrument rather than facility. Bars are real counts from data/analysis: 115 removals, TEM/STEM leading at 9. Region rates are illustrative.
